products.name: Letter Visitors
products.tagline: See website visitors on your website itself
products.description: Know who’s on your website: the people, their companies, and the AI agents reading your pages. See them on your own site, and replay their sessions.

products.name: Motionflare
products.tagline: Turn your website into a stunning launch video in minutes
products.description: Motionflare turns your website into a ready-to-share marketing video and brand film in minutes. Paste a URL and it uses your real product screenshots, logo, colors, and copy to create branded motion graphics with music and optional narration. Or switch to Film mode to generate a live-action commercial. Refine the result by chat and export in up to 4K.
maker_comments: Hi Product Hunt, I’m Joey, the founder of Motionflare. Before this, I was an engineer at Google and Tesla, and co-founded two startups as CTO. Building the products was never the hard part. The launch video was. The first one took me a week of keyframes, and it still didn’t look like what I’d made. The alternative was an agency: about $10k and a few weeks for one video. So most founders I know skip it, and the video is the first thing to go. Marketing teams hit the same wall every week. Motionflare is the video team you couldn’t hire: your writer, designer, director, animator and editor. Paste your URL and it reads your site, writes the story, takes your real logo, colors, copy and screenshots, and animates the whole thing. You get a finished video in under 10 minutes, for $29 a month instead of $10k a video. It makes two kinds: Motion : motion graphics built from your brand, up to 90 seconds Film : a live-action style ad with people, voiceover and sound, 5 to 45 seconds, up to 4K No avatars, no stock footage. When something feels off, tell your editor in plain words and only that part changes . Then export in 1080p or 4K. Your first video is free to make and preview, no card needed . You shouldn't have to pay just to see if it looks right. It's also Black Friday week, so through Dec 1, Pro and Max are 50% off your first month . That's $14.50 instead of $29 for Pro. No code needed. The discount is applied at checkout.

products.name: Gauth Personal Study Agent
products.tagline: An AI study agent that remembers where you struggle
products.description: Gauth Personal Study Agent connects the questions you snap, the quizzes you take, and the topics you study into one ongoing picture of how you learn. Instead of starting from scratch each session, it spots the gap behind a mistake, builds a short daily plan around it, and adjusts that plan when you miss a review or master a topic early. Practice comes as flashcards, guided step-by-step walkthroughs, and quizzes, with topic mastery and streaks to show progress. Built into the Gauth app.
maker_comments: Excited to hunt Gauth Personal Study Agent today. Most AI study apps, Gauth included until now, are reactive: you ask, it answers, and the next session starts from zero. Personal Study Agent connects the questions you snap, your quiz results, and your study tasks into one memory of how you learn, and then acts on it. What stood out: Spots the gap behind a mistake and adds a quick drill before your next quiz Gives you a short list of what to study today Re-plans automatically when you miss a review or master a topic early, while keeping your exam date fixed Mixes flashcards, guided step-by-step walkthroughs, and quizzes Shows topic mastery and streaks, so progress is visible It lives inside the Gauth app on iOS and Android, so the questions you already ask feed straight into it. Curious to hear from students and parents: what would make an AI study agent genuinely useful for you?

products.name: Dog Translator SuperTranslator
products.description: What if your dog could tell you what they're feeling? SuperTranslator uses AI to read your dog's body language, vocalizations and interactions with their surroundings, and turns those signals into plain English. Instead of random phrases from barks, it looks at several behavioral cues at once to help you understand what your dog might be communicating. According to our benchmarks, this is the most accurate dog translation in history.
maker_comments: Hey Product Hunt, I'm Jim, co-founder of SuperTranslator. I dreamed of turning science fiction into reality, since I was a kid. 🐶 Talking animals appeared more than 3000 years ago in literature, and only today in 2026 this became possible! 🕗 My team and I worked for 11 years (!) on this. And today is the day we're unveiling it to the world! 📓 We included 100,000 scientific studies, we used AI + science + mathematics + logic + mapping to get the basics of dog translation. We added to the team a Stanford Linguistics professor Dr. King. 🐕 Please be patient with us, this is our first unveiling to the word of 11 years of work: translation is very basic, but real! ❤️ If you love pets, as we do, give your pet a voice!

products.name: Modem
products.tagline: Find, fix, and follow up on every customer concern
products.description: Modem monitors your customer channels (support tickets, group chat, sales calls) and alerts you to problems within minutes. It can automatically open an issue, spin up a coding agent, or escalate to the right team. When the fix ships, it closes the loop with your customers. Never lose track of a request again.

products.name: Inkling 2 Mini
products.tagline: 26B looped model for coding on your laptop
products.description: Inkling 2 Mini is Thinking Machines' 26.4B open-weight model built for local agentic work. Its middle transformer layers run three times per token, adding reasoning depth without extra weights. It runs on 32GB Macs through Ollama.
maker_comments: Hi everyone! Two weeks after calling a 594B model " Small ", TML shipped one that fits on a 32GB Mac. Inkling 2 Mini is a 26B model that runs its middle layers three times for every token. Looping won't help a small model memorize the internet, so it leans on search and tools for facts. It's aimed at coding and multi-step agent work, with a memory footprint of about 20GB. The weights are on @Hugging Face , with @Ollama support for local use and @Tinker for inference and fine-tuning. There's also a variable-loop research model for anyone studying how looping affects chain-of-thought monitoring.

products.name: Polylane Swarms
products.tagline: A team of AI agents on your roughest production incidents
products.description: Put a swarm of agents on your massive production incidents. Agents investigate possible causes in parallel, share evidence and check each other's findings. You get one answer with the root cause, the evidence and a proposed fix.

products.name: Chat with Work
products.tagline: AI bots in Europe. They work. You decide.
products.description: Create a bot with a single sentence. It works for you. Create as many as you need. They start by themselves and work across 1,920+ integrations with your laptop closed. When there's a decision to take, they ask you. Every question and approval from all your bots lands in one place. You just decide. Claude Duet: US only. ChatGPT's dots: not on Pro or Plus in Europe. Gemini's Tasks: not in Europe. Not us. Chat with Work's bots run in the EU, on every plan. 300 trial credits, no card.
maker_comments: Hi Product Hunt, I'm Carmine. I make Chat with Work, and RubyLLM, the Ruby AI framework it's built on. A dozen bots run my own companies. They answer customers at Chat with Work's and Solco's front desks, fix small bugs with Claude Code and open the pull request, triage issues on my open source projects, find prospects, and list what's unpaid in Odoo every morning. I still merge the pull requests. That's what Chat with Work is for: Write one sentence, or pick one of 116 recipes, and you have a bot. No workflow to build. It starts by itself: on a time, an email, a new GitHub issue, a Slack or Discord message. It asks before it changes anything, unless you let it run. Everything waiting for you is in one place, on the web, your phone, or your computer. It runs in Europe on every plan: the app in Germany, every model in the EU. Or on your own servers. A bot can also: Create documents, presentations and spreadsheets, and edit them beside you in Google Workspace and Microsoft 365. Scan paper and print. Code on your computer, use your browser, and work with the folders you share. Answer in Slack, Teams, Discord and Campfire. Use GPT, Gemini or Claude models, your pick. It starts with 300 trial credits, no card. If you pick a plan by 31 December, this link adds 500 credits to it: https://chatwithwork.com/c/launch I'm answering all day. Tell me which chore you'd hand to a bot first!

products.name: Hydrilla
products.description: Hydrilla AI generates high-quality 3D assets from simple prompts. Designed for game developers, animation studios, and XR creators, it helps teams create production-ready models in minutes instead of days. Build faster pipelines for games, films, and immersive worlds.
maker_comments: Hey Product Hunt 👋 I'm Tharak, Co-Founder of Hydrilla AI. Creating 3D assets is still one of the most time-consuming parts of game development and animation. Artists spend hours modeling, texturing, and refining assets, often repeating the same workflows across multiple tools. My Co-Founders, Dharani, and I started building Hydrilla after experiencing this ourselves while developing a game. We spent more time creating 3D assets than actually building the game. After speaking with 120+ professional artists, we realized we weren't the only ones facing this problem. So we built Hydrilla AI , an AI-powered 3D generator that works directly within the tools artists already use. Think of it as bringing AI-powered 3D creation and Cursor-like agents into your existing 3D pipeline. With Hydrilla, you can: Generate textured 3D assets from text or images using BlueFox, our own 3D model. Create and edit 3D scenes using natural language with Hydrilla Agent. Bring AI into Blender, Maya, Unity, Unreal Engine, and more through plugins. Connect Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex through MCP to work with your 3D tools. Integrate 3D generation into custom pipelines through our API. Our goal isn't to replace artists or the tools they love. It's to remove repetitive work so they can focus on creating. Now it's your turn: https://hydrilla.ai We'd love to hear what you think! 🚀

products.description: Tell us what you do or what just happened. We match you to one of 273 technology interviews. Answer ~13 questions by voice or text, on your own time. Your answers become a bylined draft, an editor reviews and polishes it, then it publishes on HackerNoon and gets distributed around the web.
maker_comments: Hey Product Hunt, I’m David, founder of HackerNoon. I built journalistic.tech because more people should have the opportunity to share their expertise through an interview. Our editors put together 273 sets of interview questions covering jobs, startups, product launches, milestones and technology. Tell the site what you’re working on and it matches you with an interview. Answer by voice or text, whenever you want. Your answers become a draft with your byline that goes through HackerNoon’s editorial process before publication. Published posts get distributed across HackerNoon’s site, newsletters and social channels. If you’re launching here, we have two interviews for you. Your published interview gets indexed by search engines and links back to your website, so it keeps working long after launch day: Launch Day https://journalistic.tech/interview/launch-day #1 on Product Hunt Club https://journalistic.tech/interview/product-hunt-number-one-club Want to see how a good interview can go? Here’s our Ilya Sutskever interview https://hackernoon.com/an-interview-with-ilya-sutskever-co-founder-of-openai Curious what you think of the experience and what interview categories we’re missing.
